about_the_game:
ULTIMATE AUTO-RPG: GLIMMERPASS DUNGEON adds 1 bonus area "Glimmerpass mines" and 12 new armor sets that can be unlocked in a bonus dungeon. By buying this DLC you are first and foremost showing your support for Ultimate Auto-RPG and future development but you also get a load of exclusive bonus content.

NEW DUNGEON

  • Glimmerpass mines

ARMOR SETS

  • Ghost
  • Prowler
  • Headhunter
  • Predator
  • Guardian
  • Champion
  • Raider
  • Devourer
  • Sage
  • Immortal
  • Hallowed
  • Weaver

GLIMMERPASS MINES
Hundreds of years ago in the time of the magic wars, one of the elders in the great council of wizards and one of the most powerful sorcerers of that era Kanadios Sedicuus the grey turned to dark magic and began to worship the old void gods in his lust for power. He was banished from the tower and fled to the deep caverns of Glimmerpass mines where he made a pact with the Manheim Trading Company to dig for ancient artifacts. In the coming years he would help the mining expedition to find hidden secrets and unlock new paths. It was in these void infested places in the deepest darkest caverns he discovered the power of void planting and the dark fusion between plants from the magical forest of Aldora and void seeds found in the mines.
